scripts.dev: if [ -f .env ]; then set -a; . ./.env; set +a; fi; next dev apps/web
scripts.build: if [ -f .env ]; then set -a; . ./.env; set +a; fi; next build apps/web
scripts.start: if [ -f .env ]; then set -a; . ./.env; set +a; fi; next start apps/web
scripts.db:generate: if [ -f .env ]; then set -a; . ./.env; set +a; fi; prisma generate --schema packages/db/prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.db:migrate: if [ -f .env ]; then set -a; . ./.env; set +a; fi; prisma migrate dev --schema packages/db/prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.db:deploy: if [ -f .env ]; then set -a; . ./.env; set +a; fi; prisma migrate deploy --schema packages/db/prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.test:integration: if [ -f .env.test ]; then set -a; . ./.env.test; set +a; fi; node --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 apps/web/tests/integration/*.test.ts
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:e2e: if [ -f .env.test ]; then set -a; . ./.env.test; set +a; fi; playwright test --config apps/web/playwright.config.ts
